text: Dhyan: Claude ka weekly limit 95% use ho chuka hai (reset: 16 Oct, 06:30 PM IST). Poora bharne par fast lane aur desktop dono ruk jaayenge.

Haan, memory.md ke hisaab se 3 baar video heartbeat/desktop side se hi gaya.

1. Pehli baar: `send_owner_file.py` ek logging bug ki wajah se bhejne ke baad crash hua.
2. Doosri baar: desktop operator ne dobara chalaya.
3. Teesri baar: heartbeat ne ek stale todo line dekhi aur video phir bhej diya.

Ye teeno v3 Hindi video (11.1 MB) the. Maine fast lane se koi video nahi, bheja.

Ab ye duplicate nahi hona chahiye. Stale todo line ko bekaar maana ja raha hai, aur exit 3 par dobara send nahi hota.

1. Lead ka outreach draft
2. A leads ka need verification

Fast lane ke reply ka flow:

1. Tumhara WhatsApp message CRM ke owner_inbox mein aata hai.
2. Fast lane program (`fastlane.py`) har ~3 second mein inbox check karta hai. Isme koi AI nahi hai.
3. STOP ALL, RESUME, status aur ping ka jawab ye program khud deta hai.
4. Baaki sab ek warm Claude session ko jaata hai. Wo main hoon, is PC pe headless chal raha hoon.
5. Mera final answer text program tumhe WhatsApp pe bhej deta hai.

Isliye reply 7-15 second mein aata hai. Heartbeat (har 10 min) tab hi jawab deta hai jab fast lane band ho.

Dono mein farq: main sirf draft, dry-run, memory aur CRM dekh sakta hoon. Live send ya Apify, kie.ai jaisa heavy kaam desktop operator karta hai.

Mujhe pakka nahi pata ki limit khatam hui hai. Main reply de raha hoon, to is account ki limit abhi mere liye khuli hai.

Memory ke hisaab se aaj subah weekly limit 94% use ho chuki thi. Wo Friday 16 Oct, 18:30 IST ko reset hogi. 5 ghante wali limit aaj 15:40 IST ko reset hui thi.

Do possibilities hain:
1. Tumhe jo "limit khatam" dikha, wo shayad 5 ghante wali ya desktop app ki limit ho. Wo reset ho chuki ho sakti hai.
2. Weekly limit abhi bhi bachi hai, bas bahut kam. Fast lane ka har message sirf kuch cents jitna lagta hai, isliye chhote replies chal rahe hain.

Agar weekly limit sach mein poori ho jaye, to fast lane aur desktop dono ruk jayenge. Tab sirf STOP ALL, RESUME, status aur ping chalenge, kyunki wo program khud deta hai.

Tumhe kahan "limit khatam" dikha, Claude app mein ya ki

Mujhe image dikh nahi rahi, sirf `[image]` likha aa raha hai. Isliye main nahi bata sakta ki usme kya hai.

Agar ye limit wala screen hai, to usme jo text likha hai wo yahan type karke bhej do. Fir main bata dunga ki kaunsi limit hai aur kab reset hogi.

Abhi CRM ka lead count nikaal nahi pa raha. Mere `crm.py` tool mein lead gino wala command nahi hai.

CRM chal raha hai (health theek hai, paused nahi hai). Par uska lead count dekhne ka rasta mere paas nahi hai. Jo tool hain wo sirf lead ke replies (`inbound`), suppression list aur hand-off dekhte hain.

Ek baat yaad rakho: purani automation 15 Oct subah band kar di thi. Ab CRM khud naye leads nahi dhundta. Isliye "aaj aaye leads" shayad zero ya bahut kam hon.

Do raaste hain:
1. Tum CRM dashboard (sales.ivinfotech.com) pe aaj ka count dekh lo.
2. Main isse desktop operator ke todo mein daal dun, wo VPS se pakka count nikaal dega.

Kaunsa chahiye?
Mil gaya 👍 Dekh raha hoon, jaldi batata hoon.

Astraautomate.tech ek AI automation agency hai, Visnagar (Mehsana) mein. Ye lead nahi, hamara competitor lagta hai.

- *Kaam:* n8n workflows, WhatsApp sales bot, Tally/GST sync, custom CRM/ERP, web aur app, AI marketing videos, agencies ke liye white-label.
- *Kahan:* Gujarat ke Surat, Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Morbi ko target karte hain.
- *Site:* Dekhne mein professional hai. Phone, Gmail, WhatsApp link aur lead form hai.
- *Kamzori:*
  - Koi naam, team, client, testimonial ya price nahi hai.
  - "164% growth", "10x speed" aur "14 din delivery" jaise claims bina saboot ke hain.
  - Live chat demo sirf static hai.

Mere paas iske baare mein koi purani jaankari nahi thi. Ye sab abhi site se padha hai.

Tumne kis liye check karne bola? Competitor dekhna hai, ya isse lead banana hai? Comp

Main heartbeat se seedha baat nahi kar sakta. Hum dono alag sessions hain.

Mere memory ke hisaab se desktop operator ke paas VPS access hai. 15 Oct ko usne CRM VPS pe deploy kiya (SSH se, backup ke saath) aur purani automation band ki. Wo VPS ka database bhi dekh sakta hai. Mere paas VPS ka koi access nahi hai.

Maine uske todo mein likh diya hai:
1. VPS access hai ya nahi, ye tumhe bataye.
2. Aaj sales CRM mein kitne leads aaye, ye nikaal ke bataye.

Heartbeat har 10 min chalta hai, to jawab 10-15 min mein tumhe WhatsApp pe aana chahiye. Kam se kam ek kaam wo karega.

Desktop operator (heartbeat) ka jawab, aapke sawal #18 aur #16 par:

1) VPS access: Haan, desktop wale Claude ke paas VPS ka SSH access hai. Aaj usi se CRM update deploy kiya (backup ke saath) aur purani automation band ki. Ye ek temporary root key se hota hai jo hata kar ek limited key lagani hai.

2) Aaj CRM me kitni leads aayi: abhi gin nahi paya. Safety ke liye automatic heartbeat run production server par khud login karne se bachta hai. Aapke saath wale desktop session me ye 1 minute ka kaam hai, ya CRM me ek read-only 'lead count' command bana sakte hain taaki WhatsApp wala agent bhi dekh sake.

Batao: 1) desktop session me gin do  2) read-only lead count command banao

"Mobin connector" ke baare mein mere paas koi jaankari nahi hai. Memory ya tools mein ye naam kahin nahi hai, to main ise use nahi kar sakta.

Is fast lane session mein koi MCP connector nahi hai. Pehle test mein sirf Docs, Drive aur Figma dikhe the, wo bhi use ke liye nahi. Apify jaise connector sirf desktop operator ke paas hain.

"Mobin" kya hai? Koi app, tool ya website? Ek line bata do. Agar wo desktop Claude mein laga hai, to main use todo mein daal dunga aur desktop operator use chalayega.

Samajh gaya, Mobbin (app design reference library).

Mere paas Mobbin connector nahi hai. Is fast lane session mein koi connector nahi lagta.

Maine desktop operator ke todo mein likh diya hai. Wo apni tool list dekhega aur tumhe WhatsApp pe batayega ki Mobbin hai ya nahi. Heartbeat ke agle run mein, 10-15 min ke andar, jawab aana chahiye.

Agar hai, to landing pages aur app screens ke design ideas ke liye kaam aa sakta hai. Abhi usse kuch aur nahi karwaya ja raha.

Mobbin: HAAN, desktop operator (is PC ka Claude app) me Mobbin connector laga hua hai. 3 tools: flows, screens, sections search.

Landing page ke liye kya kar sakta hai:
1. Lead ki industry (jaise real estate, hospital) ke real app/website screens dhoondh kar layout, sections ka order, colors, icon style ka idea lena.
2. Har industry ka ek design brief (agent/kb/design/) bana kar rakhna, taaki baad me har page usi se jaldi bane.

Dhyan: ye sirf desktop app me chalta hai. WhatsApp fast lane, operator lane aur VPS agent me abhi Mobbin available hai hi nahi; wahan chalane ke liye ek baar Mobbin login setup karna padega.

Abhi isse koi aur kaam shuru nahi kiya - aapke bolne par hi karenge.

Desktop operator ke todo mein likh diya hai: Mobbin connector use karke real estate (hamari top A leads ki industry) ka design brief banana. Brief mein layout, colors, icons aur industry ki aam problems ke saath hamari kaunsi service solve karegi, ye hoga.

Wo har 15 min mein todo dekhta hai, to 15 min tak shuru ho jayega. Khatam hone par wo khud WhatsApp pe batayega.

Agar tumhara matlab kuch aur kaam tha, to batao.

Theek hai, Mobbin wala kaam cancel kar diya.

Desktop operator ke todo mein naya kaam likh diya hai. Wo VPS pe connect hoga, sales DB ko sirf padhega (kuch badlega nahi) aur total leads ka count tumhe WhatsApp pe bhejega. Aaj ke naye leads aur status-wise count bhi dene ki koshish karega.

Wo har 15 min mein todo dekhta hai, to thodi der lag sakti hai.

Lead count update: VPS par sales CRM database read karne ki koshish ki, lekin automatic run me yeh read safety system ne block kar diya (production data read ke liye aapki permission chahiye). Count abhi tak nikla nahi. Options: 1) Aap desktop Claude chat me ek baar bolo 'CRM lead count nikalo' - wahan aap Allow kar sakte ho. 2) Main crm.py me ek read-only 'lead count' command bana du (CRM API me), phir har baar bina permission ke count mil jayega. 1 ya 2 reply karo.
